title: The equivariant Stolz exact sequence descends to the quotient by the fundamental group
author: Massimiliano Puglisi; Thomas Schick; Vito Felice Zenobi
work: Stolz Positive Scalar Curvature Structure Groups, Proper Actions and Equivariant 2-Types
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proposition compares the G-equivariant Stolz exact sequence of a space X with the G-tilde-equivariant one of its covering X-tilde and claims they are isomorphic (statement lines 510-514). The proof constructs two inverse operations on equivariant cycles: descending a G-tilde-cycle by quotienting out the free pi_1(X)-action, and lifting a G-cycle by pulling back the covering and letting the group act on the fibre product inside M x X-tilde (proof lines 516-529). The step that carries the content is the lifting, because the G-tilde-action has to be defined on the pulled-back covering in such a way that the lifted map is equivariant, and the author writes that action down explicitly; the rest of the proof transfers metrics and bordisms through the same correspondence. The construction is elementary once the two group actions are set up correctly. H2.
